scene.primarySubject: Ezekiel standing on the riverbank, face lifted and arms slightly raised in awe, looking up toward the heavens.
scene.action: A brilliant white-gold radiance veiled by slow-moving cloud with a fire-like glow at its heart hangs above the expanse, its outline suggesting a sapphire-hued throne-light with no visible figure seated in it.
scene.setting: Flat open riverbank of the River Chebar in exile, reeds and muddy shore, with a dark cloud-bank rising over the plain.
scene.secondaryElements: Four living creatures hovering in the air beneath the expanse with lowered wings, strange and fearsome; faint reflections of the radiance on the river water; exile-period tunics and cloaks on distant Israelite and Babylonian figures on the bank.
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and quiet dread, with grief and hope held together.
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon gathering toward dusk under a stormy sky with a great north wind and thin rain-haze over the river.
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the riverbank looking upward, Ezekiel in the lower foreground, the radiant cloud and expanse filling the upper center of the frame.

scene.timeOfDay: Midday turning toward evening, clear sky with high cloud, dry dusty air, bright sunlit day with radiant glow above.
scene.composition: Micaiah centered in the foreground facing the kings, with the luminous heavenly radiance filling the upper portion of the frame.
